title: ADR 2025 basic image requirements — original instructional vector drafts
copyright_policy: Original vectors authored for this repository; no copied stock photos, proprietary textbook diagrams or externally downloaded files. Verify legal rendering and do not use files as real vehicle markings.

planned_without_question_binding.note: Future separate EQ recognition graphic should reproduce legally checked 100x100 mm mark including required class-number and consignor/consignee labels. Not bound to ADR-B-0260, which asks about the E0 code and would be misrepresented by a valid EQ mark.

design_requirements.format: SVG vector original; scale independently, true aspect proportions validated against ADR
design_requirements.accessibility: Every rendering must have own alt caption; no essential information encoded in hue alone
design_requirements.transport_use: No files may be used as official traffic or package markings without a separate compliance check
design_requirements.validation: Specialist ADR reviews layout and symbols against Polish Dz.U. 2025 poz.642 and erratum 1575; final SVG not verified
